features.notes: Verifies the 73-key model with 43 white and 30 black keys, E-to-E range.
Six ordered hardware sections with normalized section width allocation.
Control counts per section and stable IDs. Asserts only Program and Synth have primary OLED displays.
Pointer and keyboard key pressed/released state in keyboard model.
Button toggle and LED display state integration.
Pointer changes are clamped and reflected visually.
Controls have names, roles, focus behavior, and keyboard input support.
Continuous red chassis structure and no extra marketing region above the instrument.
